items.source:
Converters to potentially wrap the execution of a repository method into a variety of wrapper types potentially being
available on the classpath.
items.translation: 转换器可将仓库方法的执行包装成多种包装类型，这些类型可能存在于类路径中。

items.source: Conversion support for reactive wrapper types.
items.translation: 支持反应式包装类型的转换。
